## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD5: CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md updated: old key name removed, new key documented with same semantics

## Overview
Update plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md to:
1. Rename the section heading from review.max_resolution_attempts → review.max_cycles (line 890)
2. Update the description and metadata (Used by, Default value)
3. Update the cross-reference in review.schema_correction_max_attempts description (line 883) to mention review.max_cycles instead of review.max_resolution_attempts
4. Add a brief deprecation note: "This key replaces review.max_resolution_attempts. The old key is accepted via a backward-compat alias in read-config.sh (emits a deprecation warning) but will be removed in a future release."

## doc-router Decision
Gate 2 fires: content extends the existing CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md reference doc.
DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION: Gate 2 → plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md: modify (rename section heading, update description, add deprecation note, update cross-reference)

## Implementation

### Section at line 890 — change from:
```
### `review.max_resolution_attempts`

| | |
|---|---|
| **Description** | Maximum number of autonomous fix/defend attempts the review resolution loop makes before escalating to the user. Controls the Autonomous Resolution Loop in REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md, test-failure delegation in COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md and TEST-FAILURE-DISPATCH.md, and the oscillation-check safety bounds. |
| **Accepted values** | Positive integer |
| **Default** | `5` |
| **Used by** | `REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md` (Autonomous Resolution Loop), `COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md` (Steps 1, 1.5), `TEST-FAILURE-DISPATCH.md`, `/dso:oscillation-check` |
```

### Change to:
```
### `review.max_cycles`

| | |
|---|---|
| **Description** | Maximum number of autonomous fix/defend attempts (review cycles) the review resolution loop makes before escalating to the user. Controls the Autonomous Resolution Loop in REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md, test-failure delegation in COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md and TEST-FAILURE-DISPATCH.md, and the oscillation-check safety bounds. Values less than 2 are rejected at config load with an error. Replaces deprecated key `review.max_resolution_attempts` (still accepted via backward-compat alias in `read-config.sh`). |
| **Accepted values** | Integer ≥ 2 |
| **Default** | `4` |
| **Used by** | `REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md` (Autonomous Resolution Loop), `COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md` (Steps 1, 1.5), `TEST-FAILURE-DISPATCH.md`, `/dso:oscillation-check` |
| **Deprecated predecessor** | `review.max_resolution_attempts` — accepted with deprecation warning, will be removed in a future version |
```

### At line 883, update cross-reference:
Change "Disambiguate from `review.max_resolution_attempts`" → "Disambiguate from `review.max_cycles`"

## Consumer Detection Pass
CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md is a documentation file — no downstream code consumers. The doc-router confirms Gate 2 applies and Gate 5 (CLAUDE.md) does not.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md section heading is review.max_cycles
  Verify: grep -q '### `review\.max_cycles`' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
- [ ] Old section heading review.max_resolution_attempts is removed
  Verify: ! grep -q '### `review\.max_resolution_attempts`' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
- [ ] Default value updated to 4
  Verify: python3 -c "import re; text=open('plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md').read(); section=text[text.find('### \`review.max_cycles\`'):text.find('---', text.find('### \`review.max_cycles\`'))]; assert '\`4\`' in section, 'Default 4 not found'; print('OK')"
- [ ] Cross-reference in schema_correction section updated
  Verify: grep -q 'review\.max_cycles' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
- [ ] DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION emitted
  Verify: true  # Attestation is in this task description and must appear in sub-agent completion report

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
